confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are medium confidence: an undated Numbeo Tel Aviv basket (shekel prices) agrees with a secondary USD conversion of the same data and a July 2026 euro-denominated guide, but the shekel-to-USD rate is implied rather than verified. Accommodation anchors are low confidence: they come from undated aggregator snippets, a floor price, and a Europe-wide comparison, not from a verified Tel Aviv average. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimates from the beer price, using typical Israeli bar and restaurant ratios and local shekel price ranges from a 2025 guide. The FX rate was taken from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rate page (0.6947 for 2026-10-16, possibly provisional), not from a direct read of table F11.1.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors are based on the Tel Aviv-Yafo city basket (Numbeo-style averages) cross-checked against a July 2026 cost-of-living guide. Accommodation anchors are based on Tel Aviv hostel and hotel listing aggregates, with a Momondo 3-star average (about USD 144) as the lower reference point and other snippets as upper reference points.
